title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Aggregation in Semi-Supervised Federated Learning with non-IID Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.25794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables distributed training of machine learning models while preserving data privacy. However, FL struggles with heterogeneous, non-IID client data distributions, resulting in sub-optimal and biased global models. In this paper, we propose pFedMARL, a novel approach leveraging Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) with Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) to dynamically adapt aggregation strategies in FL settings. Our method employs a server-side agent adjusting client contributions to optimize global model robustness and client-side agents balancing global and local updates to personalize models effectively without pre-training. We demonstrate superior performance of pFedMARL for training a semi-supervised audio spectrogram transformer, matching or outperforming FedAvg, Ditto, and local training approaches across multiple non-IID scenarios and in the presence of adversarial clients. translated_title: 面向非独立同分布数据的半监督联邦学习中自适应聚合的协作多智能体强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）能够在保护数据隐私的同时实现机器学习模型的分布式训练。然而，FL在处理异构、非独立同分布（non-IID）的客户端数据分布时面临挑战，导致全局模型次优且有偏。在本文中，我们提出了pFedMARL，一种新颖的方法，利用多智能体强化学习（MARL）结合双延迟深度确定性策略梯度（TD3）来动态调整联邦学习设置中的聚合策略。我们的方法采用服务器端智能体调整客户端贡献以优化全局模型的鲁棒性，以及客户端智能体平衡全局和局部更新，从而在没有预训练的情况下有效个性化模型。我们展示了pFedMARL在训练半监督音频频谱图变换器时的优越性能，在多个非独立同分布场景以及存在对抗客户端的情况下，其性能匹配或超越了FedAvg、Ditto和局部训练方法。我们的结果...
tldr: 本文提出pFedMARL方法，通过多智能体强化学习（TD3）动态调整联邦学习聚合策略，在半监督非独立同分布数据下提升全局模型鲁棒性和个性化，性能优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes pFedMARL, which uses multi-agent reinforcement learning (TD3) to dynamically adapt aggregation strategies in federated learning, improving robustness and personalization under semi-supervised non-IID data, outperforming existing methods.
